description: Hosted remote MCP for controlling a user-paired Android phone and browser, plus authoring, previewing, scheduling, and running Melaya agent pipelines.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http melaya https://api.melaya.org/mcp

notes: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and RFC 7591 dynamic client registration.
Users approve scopes in a browser; there is no API key or environment variable to paste.
GitHub repository and OAuth protected-resource discovery document were reachable during maintainer review.
Hosted MCP endpoint returned method-gated MCP status during review.
